# Obsero ingestion

> Stream every CDN request to Obsero so AI agent traffic can be classified on request headers. Reference implementations for AWS CloudFront and Google Cloud.

Reference implementations that stream every CDN request (AWS CloudFront, Google Cloud load balancers) to Obsero so AI agent traffic can be classified on request headers. If you are a coding agent working in the repository, read AGENTS.md first: it has the contract, the setup order and the things that must not be "cleaned up".

## Docs

- [Overview](https://obsero-ai.github.io/obsero-public/index.md): Stream every CDN request to Obsero so AI agent traffic can be classified on request headers. Reference implementations for AWS CloudFront and Google Cloud.
- [Quickstart](https://obsero-ai.github.io/obsero-public/quickstart.md): Step by step: deploy a mock site, deploy the ingestion pipeline with your tracking ID, connect it to your CloudFront distributions, then tear it all down.
- [The contract](https://obsero-ai.github.io/obsero-public/contract.md): The URL you POST to and the payload Obsero expects. The only thing you have to get right.
- [AWS](https://obsero-ai.github.io/obsero-public/aws.md): CloudFront to Firehose to a Lambda adapter. Choosing a log source, measured gotchas, and cost.
- [GCP](https://obsero-ai.github.io/obsero-public/gcp.md): Load balancer request logs to Pub/Sub to a Cloud Run adapter. Named headers on the cheap path, permissions, and cost.
- [Troubleshooting](https://obsero-ai.github.io/obsero-public/troubleshooting.md): Symptom, cause, fix for both clouds. Most reported bugs are documented behaviour of the underlying service.

## Instructions for agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the contract, setup order and rules for the whole repo
- [aws/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/AGENTS.md): AWS playbook, symptom -> cause -> fix
- [gcp/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/AGENTS.md): GCP playbook, symptom -> cause -> fix

## Code

- [README.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/README.md): the same overview, as it reads on GitHub
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for a coding agent working in the repo
- [obsero.mjs](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/obsero.mjs): the contract as code: build, validate and POST an event
- [setup.sh](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/setup.sh): the interactive installer this page walks through
- [destroy.sh](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/destroy.sh): teardown, and the sweep for leftovers
- [aws/Makefile](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/Makefile): every AWS task, one make target each
- [gcp/Makefile](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/Makefile): every GCP task, one make target each
- [aws/test/adapter.test.mjs](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/test/adapter.test.mjs): the AWS adapter checked against the contract
- [gcp/test/adapter.test.mjs](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/test/adapter.test.mjs): the GCP adapter checked against the contract
- [aws/ingestion/main.tf](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/ingestion/main.tf): the pipeline: Firehose, log deliveries, backup bucket
- [aws/ingestion/variables.tf](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/ingestion/variables.tf): every module input, with its validation
- [aws/ingestion/lambda/adapter/index.mjs](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/ingestion/lambda/adapter/index.mjs): the adapter Lambda
- [aws/site/terraform/main.tf](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/site/terraform/main.tf): the demo stack: mock site plus one module block
- [aws/NOTES.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/NOTES.md): behaviour measured on live deployments
- [aws/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/aws/AGENTS.md): the AWS playbook for coding agents
- [gcp/ingestion/main.tf](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/ingestion/main.tf): the pipeline: sink, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run adapter
- [gcp/ingestion/variables.tf](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/ingestion/variables.tf): every module input, with its validation
- [gcp/ingestion/adapter/index.mjs](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/ingestion/adapter/index.mjs): the Cloud Run adapter
- [gcp/site/terraform/main.tf](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/site/terraform/main.tf): the demo stack: mock site plus one module block
- [gcp/PERMISSIONS.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/PERMISSIONS.md): the IAM roles, and why Editor is not enough
- [gcp/NOTES.md](https://github.com/Obsero-ai/obsero-public/blob/main/gcp/NOTES.md): behaviour measured on live deployments
